data.name: Cap Clean
data.description: Cap Clean Energy Corp. is a Calgary, Alberta-based clean energy development startup planning modular biofuel facilities that convert cereal crop residues and other biomass into sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and renewable diesel, with integrated CCUS. The company has signed MOUs with Raven SR (2023, Steam/CO2 Reforming technology) and ABB (2024, automation/electrification), and in May 2025 announced acquisition of a 40-acre site in Beaver County, Alberta for its first facility. It is listed on LinkedIn as a subsidiary of Aether Catalyst (ATHR.cn).
